Public Function Go(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String, state As Long, wide As Double, high As Double, across As Double
    Dim down As Double, formulas As Boolean, status As Boolean
    Application.Visible = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    state = Application.WindowState
    Application.WindowState = xlNormal
    wide = ActiveWindow.Width: high = ActiveWindow.Height
    across = ActiveWindow.Left: down = ActiveWindow.Top
    formulas = Application.DisplayFormulaBar: status = Application.DisplayStatusBar
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Activate
    s = "dpi=" & wb.Worksheets(1).StandardHeight
    Application.Width = 800: Application.Height = 600: Application.Left = 20: Application.Top = 20
    wb.Windows(1).WindowState = xlNormal
    wb.Windows(1).Left = 0: wb.Windows(1).Top = 0: wb.Windows(1).Width = 700: wb.Windows(1).Height = 500
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0: s = s & Case0(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 1: s = s & Case1(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 2: s = s & Case2(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 3: s = s & Case3(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 4: s = s & Case4(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 5: s = s & Case5(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 6: s = s & Case6(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 7: s = s & Case7(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 8: s = s & Case8(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 9: s = s & Case9(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 10: s = s & Case10(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 11: s = s & Case11(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 12: s = s & Case12(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 13: s = s & Case13(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 14: s = s & Case14(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 15: s = s & Case15(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 16: s = s & Case16(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 17: s = s & Case17(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 18: s = s & Case18(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 19: s = s & Case19(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 20: s = s & Case20(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 21: s = s & Case21(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 22: s = s & Case22(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 23: s = s & Case23(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 24: s = s & Case24(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 25: s = s & Case25(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 26: s = s & Case26(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 27: s = s & Case27(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 28: s = s & Case28(wb.Windows(1))
    Case 29: s = s & Case29(wb.Windows(1))
    End Select
    Err.Clear
    s = s & " dpi=" & wb.Worksheets(1).StandardHeight
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayFormulaBar = formulas
    Application.DisplayStatusBar = status
    Application.WindowState = xlNormal
    ActiveWindow.Width = wide: ActiveWindow.Height = high
    ActiveWindow.Left = across: ActiveWindow.Top = down
    Application.WindowState = state
    Go = s
End Function
